title: Evaluating Scalable Supervised Learning for Synthesize-on-Demand Chemical Libraries.
summary: Read ChemRxiv v1 PDF/record and PMC full article. Supervised screening of synthesize-on-demand library; prospective tests found 31/68 PriA-SSB inhibitors, including 1.3 µM hit. Narrowly an in-vitro target-inhibitor discovery; v1 already contains result, predating journal version.
